findings.claim: Aena 9M 2026 業績稿載明部長會議已於 2026-09-15 核准 DORA III（2027–2031）
findings.source: Aena press: Aena earns a profit of 1,774.7 million euros in the first nine months of 2026

findings.claim: DORA III 最終 WACC 8.32%、年均機場費 +0.33%，部長會議 9/15 核准
findings.excerpt: The WACC is set at 8.32%, and average annual airport charges will rise by 0.33%. Regulated OpEx is projected to grow from €1.929 billion in 2027 to €2.079 billion in 2031, reflecting inflation and regulatory demands.

regulated_rate_case_roe.note: Quartr 2026-09-21 投資人更新摘要稱最終 WACC 8.32%、年均費率 +0.33%（介於 CNMC 7.44% 與 Aena 9% 之間），為二手摘要，未讀到原文，建議對照官方；DORA IV 無決定。Aena 申請 2027–31 管制資本支出約 €9.991bn（thecorner.eu）；未找到 RAB 數字。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
